enabled.hint: Off: she only goes online when the owner sends /surf.

outings_per_day.hint: At random times between start_hour and end_hour.

end_hour.hint: No outings after this hour (24 = midnight).

owner_idle_minutes.description: Wait while the owner is chatting (minutes)
owner_idle_minutes.hint: An outing waits until the owner has been quiet this long.

self_outings_per_day.description: Outings she may start herself per day
self_outings_per_day.hint: With the surf_now tool, only in the owner's private chat. Scheduled outings and /surf do not count. 0: she cannot go online by herself.

asked_outings_per_day.description: Extra outings per day when the owner asks for them
asked_outings_per_day.hint: When the owner asks her to go online in the private chat (and says so in that message), surf_now ignores self_outings_per_day and the rest; this is the ceiling for such outings. 0: asking does not help, her own limits apply.

asked_min_gap_minutes.description: Least gap between outings the owner asks for (minutes)
asked_min_gap_minutes.hint: Keeps a loop or a double tool call from sending her out again and again.

self_cooldown_minutes.hint: She cannot go out herself again sooner, and a scheduled outing waits as well. Drifts by timing_jitter each time.

timing_jitter.description: How much the rest after an outing drifts

sources.hint: Built-in: bilibili_popular, bilibili_ranking, gcores, ithome, sspai, v2ex, github_trending, hackernews.

search_sources.description: Search sites (for what she wants to look up)
search_sources.hint: bilibili_search; web_search (DeepSeek Search: pages from the whole web, opened with DeepSeek Fetch; needs a DeepSeek key, $0.75 per 1000 calls). Only the topic words are sent. Empty: no searching.

read_pages.hint: Search results, and items whose list says little (Hacker News, GitHub...), are read through DeepSeek Fetch (the page is downloaded by DeepSeek, not by this machine). At most max_picks calls per outing.

deepseek_api_key.description: DeepSeek API key for search and reading pages (optional)
deepseek_api_key.hint: Empty: the key of AstrBot's DeepSeek provider (api.deepseek.com) is used.

read_videos.description: Watch the Bilibili videos she opens
read_videos.hint: Reads the subtitles (needs a Bilibili account: send /surf_bili_login and scan the QR code; a second account is best). Without subtitles: a few frames for the vision model.

video_frames.description: Look at frames when a video has no subtitles
video_frames.hint: Three frames from Bilibili's preview sheets (no video is downloaded), described by the vision model.

vision_provider_id.hint: Empty: the first provider whose modalities include image.

frames_videos_per_outing.description: Videos looked at with the vision model per outing
frames_videos_per_outing.hint: A local vision model is slow; the others keep their title and description.

blocked_keywords.hint: Items whose title or text contains one of these are never shown to her. Add what you do not want her to read or talk about.

dailyhot_url.hint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:6688 — a DailyHotApi you run yourself (github.com/imsyy/DailyHotApi). Empty: not used.

dailyhot_routes.hint: e.g. zhihu, weibo, ngabbs, miyoushe. Only used with dailyhot_url.

inject_recent.description: Tell her what she saw lately
inject_recent.hint: Adds a short note to the system prompt, so she can bring it up right away.

recent_hours.description: How far back that note goes (hours)

owner_ids.hint: Who may use /surf and /surf_log. Empty: taken from the memory-core plugin.

owner_command_platforms.hint: /surf and /surf_log only work for the owner, in a private chat, on these platforms. Everyone else gets no answer.

persona_prompt.hint: With memory-core her identity documents are used. Empty: AstrBot's default persona.

llm_provider_id.hint: Empty: the one AstrBot is using.
